audience: staffing managers who review rotas, worklogs and absence dates in Smartplan

useCases.title: Review upcoming shifts by location and role
useCases.text: Review upcoming shifts alongside locations and job roles in the connected account. Continue through additional pages when needed.

useCases.title: Compare planned and attended hours
useCases.text: Review recorded worklogs for the period and open individual records to compare planned and attended hours.

useCases.title: Review absence dates before scheduling
useCases.text: Check absence dates in the connected account and inspect individual records without returning absence reasons, categories or notes.

useCases.title: Check the connected account and timezone
useCases.text: Confirm which account the connection uses and review its settings and timezone before interpreting dates in shifts and worklogs.
